title: Quality deep-dive: design the slower higher-quality solve path from the cause table (REQ-0066)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 cause table from saved runs
AC2 design with >=3 options, cost, gain, recommendation
AC3 first option implemented after design accepted (60.1-60.3 free first)

design.summary: Cause-ranked quality plan: option value to letter, saved-run recheck, needs_review reasons, image scope for cut/declined then doubt, optional adjudication, metrics; paid checks P1-P3 with caps

implementation.summary: 60.1 option value to letter, 60.2 run-stats recheck, 60.3 needs_review_why, 60.7 metrics rows (slice A; 60.4-60.6 image scope follow-up)

unit_test.result: 1142 run, only the known baseline failures (head-failures identical to baseline); mutations on option_for_value and recheck killed; prompts identical on 15 inputs; recheck on saved runs 7 cleared 2 still failed; mock only

security.result: no finding; pure mapping returns None when unsure, no network

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; run-stats recheck on saved runs; mutations
verification.result: slice A (60.1-60.3, 60.7) verified: 1144 tests, only baseline failures; recheck on saved runs clears 7 of 8 Science false alarms, q17 and Vietnamese q20 stay failed; default solve path unchanged; defects D1 D2 D4 (tester) and option_for_value multi-number (verifier) fixed; 60.4-60.6 image scope open for a follow-up task; mapped letters not compared to a key
